_doc: Mister To players module. Constants fitted on NBA regular seasons 2010-11..2021-22 (props: 2011-12..2021-22), validated on 2022-23 and 2023-24. See report.md.

impact.formula: impact_pts = ppg*ppg_c + rpg*rpg_c + apg*apg_c + pm*pm_c + mpg*mpg_c (per-game averages with this team this season; pm = +/- per game). Points of team margin vs. replacement. No clamp at 0 (clamping was slightly worse out-of-sample).
impact.f_rule: f = sum_i w_i*played_i / sum_i w_i over the team's games this season, w_i = 0.5^((n-1-i)/20) (same weights as engine.js HALF=20)
impact.team_adjust: absence_pts(team) = sum_OUT impact*f  -  sum_RETURNING impact*(1-f)   (returning = plays today, f<1)
impact.apply: known before the line: subtract from the team-model margin only, m = W*mkt + (1-W)*(mModel - absH + absA). Full amount on top of the line only for news the line has not absorbed yet.

props.formula: S=(gp*szn+K*prev)/(gp+K) (szn if no prev); L10,L5 fall back to S; base=a+wS*S+wL10*L10+wL5*L5; mu=max(0, base*(1+c_opp*(allow-1)+c_home*(home-0.5)+c_vac*vac/TEAMTOT+c_min*clamp(L5min/sznmin-1,-0.6,0.6)))
props.vac_rule: vac_X = sum over teammates j (gp_j>=5) of (f_j - playing_j)*X_pg_j ; playing_j=0 if OUT, 1 otherwise
props.allow_rule: allow_X(opp) = ((sum X conceded by opp this season) + 10*league_avg_X_per_team_game)/(n_opp_games+10) / league_avg_X_per_team_game
props.probability: P(X>line) via negative binomial with mean mu and variance max(sd^2, 1.05*mu): r=mu^2/(var-mu), p=r/(r+mu); or normal: 1-Phi((line-(mu-shift*sd))/sd)

tiny_optional: back-to-back (-1..-2%, does not improve out-of-sample MAE)
team expected margin (-2% per 10 pts favourite)
noise: team defensive rating beyond stat-specific allowance
